title: RichInteraction finite coupled scientific CLI request

t.description: Positive hopping magnitudes in strong-hopping energy units; actual default [1,.65,1,.65]

omega.description: Primitive oscillator frequencies, not inferred photon mass or Maxwell stiffness

g.description: Dimensionless coupling of quantum link coordinates into Peierls phase

photon_levels.description: Finite oscillator levels per mode; total photon dimension is levels squared

mode_momenta.description: Standing-wave momenta in inverse link length, real part of plane-wave link integral used

mode_polarizations.description: Real physical mode polarizations; supplied default transverse unit vectors

external_phase.description: Static oriented dimensionless number-phase source phi; default zero

frequencies.description: Full retarded photon/current tensor samples; actual [.4,.75,1.05,1.4]

eta.description: Causal spectral broadening for tensor samples; .035 default; not physical damping derived from substrate

G_omega.description: Spin-up 4site charged Green function frequency; default .6

vertex_direction.description: Static phase-source direction for relaxed amputated Gamma; default [.2,.4,-.3,.1]

scattering.description: Source q,epsilon and receiver q,epsilon. Pure link integral inserts these into the SAME H derivatives. Outgoing energy determined per exact receiver, not supplied from another law.

electron_params.description: Literal RichElectron peer single-mode law parameters. This is a separate same-H consumer, not a way to mix different laws' G and D.

state_semantics: Own initial Nup3,Ndown2 ground, charge -1 and physical spin+1/2; all receivers actual exact coupled same-sector eigenvectors. Peer selects spin-up member of exact N5 eigenspace. Peer N4-reference G labeled separate state.
current_semantics: J=-dH/d(number-link-phase), electric electron charge current -J; C=d2H/dphase2; each external source/receiver uses same declared edge ordering and normalization
source_semantics: Unit-amplitude plane wave epsilon exp(i q.x), exact straight-link integral; not a canonical free-photon asymptotic state or invented incident flux
units: hbar=abs(electron charge)=nearest-link length=strong hopping=1; frequency/energy same units, momentum inverse length
output_encoding: Every complex scalar is [real,imag]; complex ndarray appends final length2 axis. Other real arrays ordinary. Scientific module does not invoke a hidden schema validator.
